method: one warmup each plus five AB/BA measured pairs, same existing configuration, exact six-field validation per run
resources: fresh disposable 4 CPU / 4 GiB OLAP per scenario; Doris BE 60%; PG unchanged; 6 GiB between-run database storage guard
retention: Require byte equality, failure checks, constrained-heap improvement and no median throughput regression against prior runtime in these four groups. A failed performance condition requires revision or reverting the relevant production prototype; no 25%/50% claim from memory alone.
